# P1.06 — Run sheet (full), command palette, one command grammar

Spec: `docs/tickets/34_P1.06__run-sheet-palette-commands.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.06.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `api` + `web` to `dev`, bounded
live verify, $0 baseline) is operator-gated → **D-P1.06-1**.

## Summary

Every cost-bearing action now converges on the one §5.6 sheet — in its full two-tier form inside the
pane system — and the `⌘K` palette plus the §7.2 grammar make every workflow reachable, scoped, and
keyboard-first, **without the palette ever launching a run**. The grammar lives in a new leaf package
(`@rhema/commands`, deps: `@rhema/contracts` only — browser- and server-safe): one verb table driven
off `WORKFLOW_KEYS`, one parser, one resolver, so the palette, the §7.4 selection popover, the
Timeline context menu, and (P1.11) the chat composer all produce a **byte-identical** run-sheet GET
from the same command (REQ-CHAT-21/22). Scoped runs are real end-to-end: `POST /runs {scope}` →
`runs.scope` + `inputs`/`input_snapshot`, scope-keyed corr locks, and a scoped estimate beside the
whole-draft figure. The PRB.21 guard relaxes **as recorded** — per-project → per-write-lock:
read-only runs (including scoped readers) parallelize; writers stay exclusive (§6.3, §12.4). Launching
on a working head promotes it atomically with the run row ("will be promoted to vN" made true).

## What landed

**`packages/commands` (new leaf)** — the §7.2 grammar: `VERB_TABLE` (10 MVP verbs + 8 one_x verbs
marked, data-driven off the workflow registry), scope refs (`@v3`, `@v3 §II`, `@section:…`,
`@selection`, `@outline`, `@review:vN`, `@finding:vN/m`, `@claim:vN/n`, `@figure:…`, `@thread`,
`words` for the trial slice), levers (`--rigor/--tier/--stage/--protocol/--venue/--wait/--auto/--no-*
toggles/--budget/…`), the free-text → guidance tail, unknown-verb correction (never guessed), chip
labels that never render `--`, and `resolveCommand` → `{sheet|navigate|disabled}` — sheet routes are
`/p/:slug/run?…`, never a run POST (REQ-CHAT-25).

**`packages/ide`** — `keymap.ts`: the full §5.12 dispatcher (`⌘K`, `⌘1/2/J`, `⌘⇧M/F/L/T`, `⌘S`,
`⌘⇧R`, `⌘⇧D/E/V`, `⌘G`, `⌘I`, `⌘,`, `⌘⇧C`, `[`/`]`, `⌘Z/⌘⇧Z`, `?`, bare `/` → command mode) —
findings chords are scoped to Margin/Findings focus, **inert while the caret is in the Page**.
`palette.ts`: the palette model (Run pinned next-step-with-estimate → verbs → Go to → Recent runs →
Threads → Settings; `/` → the structured command row). `menus.ts`: the selection-popover + Timeline
context-menu item models over the same grammar.

**`packages/run-sheet` + `packages/ui`** — the full two-tier sheet: title line, **Rigor** (first-class;
Quick · Standard · Full board with consequence copy + model-tier outcome), the dollars-first estimate
box (`≈ $… · never more than $…` + credits/cap/balance + "Why this estimate?"), provisional → in-place
refine (inline script, Run never disabled waiting), trial **Included** rendering (no dollars/cap/
consent; locked tiers priced; >6,000-word offer → a `words` scope pill), the collapsed row →
protocol/venue/stage/voice fields, guidance + standing-notes count, Advanced toggles with **signed
credit deltas**, Budget cap editable **upward only**, Approvals pick, "don't ask under N credits"
(max 1,000), REQ-SPEC-17 scope-policy consequence line, obligation-scope lines, promote-on-launch
line, insufficient-balance resolution panel. `RunButton` still carries the lint-required estimate.

**`packages/orchestrator`** — the recorded concurrency ruling: the creation guard moves from
per-project to **per-write-lock** (`firstConflict` over frozen `lock_set`; `draft:read:*` shared,
`corr:<draft>:<kind>:<k>:<scope>` discriminates scoped readers, `ns:write`/`draft:write` exclusive);
promote-on-launch freezes a `working` head in the create tx (`cause:'run_read'`); `runs.scope` +
`inputs.scope` + `input_snapshot.scope` persistence.

**`packages/db`** — migration `0031_consent_threshold.sql` (`user.consent_dont_ask_under`) + Drizzle.

**`apps/api`** — `POST /runs` accepts `scope` (canonical serialized → parsed refs → `runs.scope`),
guidance (→ a run-scope Guidance row), `approvalPolicy` (→ `projects.approval_policy`),
protocol/venue/stage (frozen into `inputs`; the REQ-SPEC-17 `scopeBlocking` flag is **server-derived**),
cap floored `Math.max(body, computed)`; `GET /projects/:id/run-sheet-context` (entitlement, consent
pref, head facts, `blockedBy` under the per-lock ruling); `GET/PUT /settings/consent`; estimates take
`scope` (in the cache key); the project search powers the palette's same-origin proxy; the dossier
labels a scoped run (`scopeLabels` chips). Fix: the stale `Revise using your edits` re-POST resolves
a memo-backed frozen child so idempotency dedupes instead of 409ing under promote-on-launch.

**`apps/web`** — `/p/:slug/run` GET renders the full sheet (context fetch, `?scope=`/lever query →
pills + scoped-vs-whole estimate, `scopeBlocking` line, entitlement *Included*); POST forwards the
expanded form; the `ide.ts` island wires the palette (browse/command/search modes, ↑/↓/Enter,
GET-only activation), the cheat sheet, the shared keymap, the §7.4 selection popover, and the
Timeline context menu — every command through `parseCommand → resolveCommand`, nothing POSTs.
`GET /p/:slug/palette-search` proxies project-scoped search same-origin.

## Stage B handoff (operator)

Deploy `api` + `web` to `dev` (`pulumi preview` first), apply migration `0031`, then the $0 headless
asserts: `POST /projects/:id/estimates` returns estimate+cap+levers; the sheet renders both tiers +
`Included`/insufficient states; the palette parses `/review @section:…` and routes to the sheet GET —
no run launched. Optional ≤$8: one scoped `review/quick @section` to observe `runs.scope` + the
labelled dossier live — the operator's call, not a gate.
